review.verdict: Alive all raid for once, 93 average, and the two lower parses were the bosses' doing
review.summary: No deaths in BWL, which after the three on 2 October counts as personal growth. Razorgore 96, Firemaw 99, Broodlord and Ebonroc 97, a 93 average against your usual 77. Chromaggus (90) and Nefarian (84) look like soft spots but aren't: on Chromaggus his weakness was a school you can't use for half the fight and you switched to Fireball whenever it turned to fire, and on Nefarian the mage call made casting a liability for 30 seconds.

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Zero deaths in eight boss pulls and the trash in between. On 2 October you managed three before Chromaggus.

good.title: Firemaw 99
good.text: Equal to your best, and second highest damage of the raid on Razorgore with a 96.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: Supreme Power, Zanza, Greater Arcane, Frost Power and Mageblood on every pull: 5.7 buffs a pull against 4 for the other DPS.

good.title: Chromaggus: played the weakness
good.text: Whenever his Elemental Shield turned to fire (0:17 to 0:41 and from 1:05) you switched to Fireball for 5 to 9k a hit; the rest of the fight Frostbolt did about 400. The 90 is the boss, not you.

fix.title: Food
fix.text: Mana Regeneration food on 4 of 6 pulls with a buff snapshot. That's the whole list: the two lower parses were mechanics.

fix.title: Vaelastrasz
fix.text: 89 and twentieth in raid damage, about your usual 88 there.

50616.text: Switched to Fireball on each fire weakness.

50617.text: Wild Magic (the mage call) from 1:19 to 1:49: not casting was the job.

review.verdict: 99 on five bosses, which in a cat is worth fifth place on the meter
review.summary: Firemaw, Ebonroc, Chromaggus and Nefarian 99, Flamegor 98, Vaelastrasz 97 (your usual there is 76), a 97 average, no deaths, all seven world buffs and a Juju on every pull. It's hard to find anything to complain about, so we'll settle for this: all those 99s added up to fifth on the damage meter on Ebonroc and Nefarian, behind four warriors who parsed lower.

good.title: Five 99s and a 98
good.text: Firemaw, Ebonroc, Chromaggus, Nefarian 99, Flamegor 98. Vaelastrasz 97 is your best ever there (96 before).

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Mongoose, Juju Power, Juju Might, Scorpok and food on all six pulls with a snapshot, 5.7 buffs a pull against 4 for the other DPS.

fix.title: Razorgore
fix.text: 90. Your worst boss of the night and still over your usual 89. This is the fix list. That's how little there is.

fix.title: Idle starts on the drakes
fix.text: 10 to 14 seconds without a swing at the start of Firemaw, Ebonroc and Flamegor. Everyone else's start was about as slow, so it's the raid's opener, not you, but you asked for something.

review.verdict: Seventeen points over your usual, 31 Demoralizing Shouts, and no flask
review.summary: A 77 average against your usual 60, with Firemaw 94, Chromaggus 91 and Broodlord 90 the high points, and no deaths. You kept Demoralizing Shout up on the bosses (31 casts) and put Sunder Armor on too. The weak spots are Nefarian (72, usually 83) and Ebonroc, where you were the second lowest warrior.

good.title: Well over your usual
good.text: Firemaw 94 (usual 80), Chromaggus 91 (84, a personal best), Broodlord 90 while tanking, Vaelastrasz 73 (53).

good.title: Demoralizing Shout
good.text: 31 Demoralizing Shouts and 17 Sunder Armors over the raid.

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Zero deaths in eight boss pulls.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 3.2 buffs a boss pull against 5 for the other tanks: Zanza, Mongoose and Giants every pull, but no flask, no food and Gordok Green Grog once.

fix.title: Nefarian and Ebonroc
fix.text: Nefarian 72 against your usual 83, and Ebonroc 76 with 13 seconds of nothing at the start, tenth of eleven warriors.

fix.title: Chromaggus breath
fix.text: Frost Burn hit you for 2,125, more than anyone it caught.
